items.text: The Linux pane sidebar lists every window and searches them.
The Linux pane banner folds to its title row on a click, and Ctrl+Shift+B opens its editor.
Linux pane banners survive a relaunch and an agent recovery, and keep the session-interrupted notice out of their slot.
Linux banner links get the shared right-click menu, and the window title shows when a pane is busy or waiting on a question.
test/linux/cli-pane-drag.sh is executable like its siblings.
Layout-recovery test's 'extra session' red was already fixed.
The menu check no longer mistakes a pending update row for a broken menu.
The session-restore test now really resizes the window before checking the pane follows.
Window > Float on Top lands on the first choice again.
A divider drag is proven to carry the pane banner in the same pass.
